role: The single-biome biome source the Nether (hell) and the End (sky) register: every query returns the one biome and a fixed rainfall.
scope_reason: The Nether and the End are vanilla and in scope (SPEC Decisions).

members.name: rainfall
members.note: only read through getRainfall, unused natively

members.name: getBiomeGenAt
members.note: Nether and End chunks get their biome array at generation (loadBlockGeneratorData in ChunkProviderHell/End.provideChunk) and from S21 on the client, so Chunk.getBiomeGenForWorldCoords never falls back to the manager; World.getBiomeGenForCoordsBody asks it only for a chunk that does not exist, and every server caller reads a loaded chunk

members.name: getBiomesForGeneration
members.note: called only by ChunkProviderGenerate (the overworld) and the overworld structure generators, never on this manager

members.name: loadBlockGeneratorData
members.note: the Nether fills DIM_BIOME_HELL inline in load_dim_chunk

members.name: getBiomeGenAt
members.note: called only by BiomeCache.Block (the WorldChunkManager.getBiomeGenAt(int,int) and loadBlockGeneratorData paths, both overridden here), so never on the Nether or End manager

members.name: func_150795_a
members.note: spawn search is overworld-only; no native caller in other dimensions found

members.name: areBiomesViable
members.note: no structure in the Nether/End asks it

notes: world.c world_get_biome falls back to the overworld layer stack for an unloaded chunk regardless of dimension; whether any Nether/End caller can reach that fallback was not verified.
